Senses.Explanation: A grant-of-doubt formula — no harm dwelling on that — the answer-turn that hands the question back as working material, asked across the Song case-comments and the Ming-Qing halls. Langye Huijue's comment, carried in Wansong Xingxiu's appraisal of Yaoshan's wordless ascent — the master seated a long while, come down, gone to quarters, the prior pressing him: you promised to teach, why not one word? sutras have sutra masters, treatises have treatise masters, how is it the old monk's fault? — and Langye's grant: Yaoshan coming down from the seat, no harm doubting that; pressed by the prior, he lost an eye, and Wansong adds the ruling: how many ever get whole again, not knowing he traded up to two; Feiyin Tongrong takes the newborn Buddha's one hand to heaven and one to earth — a blow, do you get it? — then, told of the six snow mountain years and the morning star: no harm doubting that; the monk points to the sky: then he is the thus-come one — not yet dreamt of; Lingji Xingguan makes the grant the gate itself in the room-testing: not yet arrived here, no harm doubting; arrived here, ice melts and tiles crack — doubt-dwelling set aside, what is the ice melting? thanks for today's release from the hall — and what is the release's very point? two claps — still two or three; and Shiqi Tongyun, asked at the prefect's vegetarian feast how one who knows conducts the day — dressing, eating — and when there is neither dressing nor eating, what then? — hands it back: layman, no harm dwelling in doubt on that. Liangting Jingting, asked in open question-and-answer whose hand wrote the Crane-burial Elegy — some say Wang Xizhi, some Tao Hongjing, true and false past telling, error handed down as error, when does it end? — grants the doubt whole; Baochi Xuanzong, at the bodhisattva's birthday when the lay patroness brings the robe: today's giver of a robe gains how much blessing? — no harm doubting that; and the golden-maned lion cub sees through the tangle a thousand miles off — but no rushing this; Gusu Zun, at the hanging of the Chan worker's bell: one staff's clear sound, the three wretched roads' bitterness stopped — is that supernatural power, or subtle working? — no harm doubting that — and then the exchange of shouts, each shout asked after its taste, the second met with a blow; and Zhufeng Zhenxu, at the Ullambana assembly, works the grant into verse — rain teasing the toad, the mouth striking the banana leaf: no harm dwelling in doubt on the mid-crossing; a toad's nostrils three fathoms long, howling the moon and humming the wind through the ninefold heavens.
